description_en: Queries all replication slots of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询实例的所有Replication Slot
name: DescribeSlots

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can generate the token on your client and ensure that it is unique across different requests. The client token supports only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. This parameter can be left empty
parameters.name: resource_group_id

schema.description_en: The details of the response parameters

Slots.description_en: The list of replication slots of the instance

items.description_en: The replication slot of the instance

Database.description_en: The name of the database where the replication slot resides
Database.description_zh: Replication Slot所在的数据库名称

Plugin.description_en: The plug-in used by the replication slot

SlotName.description_en: The name of the replication slot

SlotStatus.description_en:
The status of the replication slot. Valid values:
ACTIVE: Active.
INACTIVE: Inactive
SlotStatus.description_zh:
Replication Slot状态。
ACTIVE：活跃。
INACTIVE：不活跃

SlotType.description_en:
The type of the replication slot. Valid values:
physical: Physical.
logical: Logical
SlotType.description_zh:
Replication Slot类型。
physical：物理。
logical：逻辑

SubReplayLag.description_en: The logical subscription latency of the subscriber corresponding to the replication slot. Unit: seconds
SubReplayLag.description_zh: 当前Replication Slot对应订阅端的逻辑订阅的具体延迟，单位为秒（s）

Temporary.description_en:
Specifies whether the replication slot is temporary. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No
Temporary.description_zh:
Replication Slot是否为临时性的。
true：是。
false：否

WalDelay.description_en: The amount of accumulated logs in the replication slot
